rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for washing yourself or taking a bath.

example.english: I’ll bathe first, then eat with you later.
example.traditional: 我沖涼先，陣間再同你食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cung1 loeng4 sin1 zan6 gaan1 zoi3 tung4 nei5 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when you wash or bathe another person, especially a baby, rather than yourself.

example.english: I bathe my son every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 bong1 go3 zai2 cung1 loeng4

rows.note: Use this for rinsing or flushing a body part with water or another liquid.

example.english: Bathe the wound with clean water first.
example.jyutping: jung6 cing1 seoi2 cung1 sai2 soeng1 hau2 sin1

rows.note: Use this when light, mist, or a similar thing envelops or covers an area.

example.english: Morning mist can bathe the whole hillside.
example.traditional: 朝早嘅薄霧籠罩住成個山頭。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 ge3 bok6 mou6 lung4 zaau3 zyu6 sing4 go3 saan1 tau4
